definition.name: [InterSystems IRIS] Interoperability queue depth is abnormally high in namespace {{id.name}}

description: Tracks the number of messages waiting in a namespace's interoperability queues. A queue that grows well beyond its normal depth usually means a business host has stalled or a downstream system has stopped accepting messages, and messages will keep accumulating until the backlog is cleared.
title: Interoperability queue depth is abnormally high
